name: Factory Frenzy: Toy Rush
summary:
Accept the challenge of operating a toy-packing factory as a single staff under the pressure of a tough Boss while time is ticking for the orders to dispatch. Operate the Fork-lift to load orders in truck while rush to the racks to load more and more toys. Sort through the toys in try for each order and fold, staple and label each carton in time.
